title: Recover Non-Recoverable Fault: AGV Stuck Using Operator Station HMI (Visu_ManControl → CellIO Status → OUT W1 forced value)
summary: On the operator station HMI, verify the non-recoverable AGV-stuck fault by confirming the selected tipper shows OUT Fault Status = 82 on the CellIO Status screen. Then force OUT W1 to either 3 (continue work) or 32771 (send the AGV to the hospital) by entering the value, checking the enable checkbox, waiting 10 seconds, and unchecking. Finally, press CYCLE START to restart operation.
when_to_use: Use when an AGV remains at the tipper after tote-tipping is complete (non-recoverable fault), and the operator station HMI indicates the AGV-stuck condition that requires forcing OUT W1 via the CellIO Status screen.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the HMI verification (Visu_ManControl → CellIO Status), select the stuck tipper, apply the documented OUT W1 forced value (3 or 32771) with the enable checkbox for 10 seconds, then uncheck and press CYCLE START.
access_or_tools_needed: HMI controls/fields: tipper selection, "OUT Fault Status", "OUT W1" forced value box, checkbox enabling the forced value, "CYCLE START" button

system_preconditions: An AGV remains at the tipper after tote-tipping is complete (AGV stuck non-recoverable fault condition).

steps.title: Navigate to Visu_ManControl
steps.purpose: Open the operator station HMI screen that provides access to the CellIO Status screen for tipper I/O verification and forced-value recovery.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_ManControl" screen.
steps.expected_result: The "Visu_ManControl" screen is displayed on the operator station HMI.
steps.healthy_condition: The HMI is on the "Visu_ManControl" screen and the "CellIO Status" button is available for selection.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot access the "CellIO Status" button because the HMI is not on the "Visu_ManControl" screen.

steps.title: Open CellIO Status
steps.purpose: Access the tipper-specific I/O status and forced-value controls needed to recover the AGV stuck fault.
steps.instruction: Press the "CellIO Status" button on the "Visu_ManControl" screen.
steps.expected_result: The CellIO Status screen (cell control input/output values per tipper) is opened.
steps.healthy_condition: The CellIO Status screen shows tipper selection and the OUT Fault Status / OUT W1 forced value controls for the selected tipper.
steps.failure_condition: The CellIO Status screen does not open or the OUT Fault Status / OUT W1 forced value controls are not visible.

steps.title: Select the stuck tipper
steps.purpose: Ensure the OUT Fault Status and OUT W1 forced value controls apply to the specific tipper where the AGV is stuck.
steps.instruction: Select the tipper where the AGV is stuck.
steps.expected_result: The selected tipper on the CellIO Status screen corresponds to the tipper where the AGV is currently stuck.
steps.healthy_condition: The tipper selection reflects the correct stuck tipper, and the OUT Fault Status field updates for that tipper.
steps.failure_condition: A different tipper than the one with the stuck AGV is selected (leading to an incorrect OUT Fault Status value).

actions.label: Select stuck tipper
actions.exact_action: Select the tipper where the AGV is stuck.

steps.title: Verify OUT Fault Status = 82
steps.purpose: Confirm the fault condition matches the documented non-recoverable AGV stuck fault before applying the forced OUT W1 value.
steps.instruction: Verify the "OUT Fault Status" field shows value 82 for the selected stuck tipper.
steps.expected_result: "OUT Fault Status" shows value 82 for the selected tipper.
steps.healthy_condition: "OUT Fault Status" equals 82 on the CellIO Status screen for the selected tipper.
steps.failure_condition: "OUT Fault Status" is not 82 for the selected tipper.

actions.label: Check OUT Fault Status
actions.exact_action: The OUT Fault Status should have a value of 82.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if "OUT Fault Status" does not show value 82 for the selected stuck tipper.

steps.title: Enter OUT W1 forced value (3 or 32771)
steps.purpose: Apply the documented forced value to OUT W1 to either continue work or send the AGV to the hospital, depending on the required outcome.
steps.instruction: Ensure the correct tipper is selected, then enter a forced value in the "OUT W1" forced value box: use 3 if the tote and AGV are ready to continue working, or 32771 if the AGV needs to go to the hospital.
steps.expected_result: The "OUT W1" forced value box contains either 3 or 32771 as selected for the recovery outcome.
steps.healthy_condition: The forced value entered matches the intended recovery path: 3 for continue work, 32771 for hospital routing.
steps.failure_condition: The wrong forced value is entered for the intended outcome (e.g., 3 when the AGV must go to the hospital).

actions.label: Enter OUT W1 forced value
actions.exact_action: Enter a value of 3 in the OUT W1 forced value box if the tote and AGV are ready to continue working. If the AGV needs to go to the hospital, enter a value of 32771.

steps.title: Enable the forced OUT W1 value
steps.purpose: Apply the forced OUT W1 value by enabling it via the checkbox next to the introduced forced value.
steps.instruction: Check the box next to the value introduced in the forced value box.
steps.expected_result: The checkbox enabling the forced OUT W1 value is checked (enabled).
steps.healthy_condition: The forced-value enable checkbox is checked for the entered OUT W1 value.
steps.failure_condition: The checkbox is not checked (forced value not enabled).

actions.label: Check enable checkbox
actions.exact_action: Check the box next to the value introduced in the forced value box.

steps.title: Wait 10 seconds, then uncheck OUT W1 forced value
steps.purpose: Apply the forced OUT W1 value for the documented duration, then remove the forced enable to complete the recovery action.
steps.instruction: Wait 10 seconds, then uncheck the box for value OUT W1.
steps.expected_result: After 10 seconds, the OUT W1 forced-value enable checkbox is unchecked.
steps.healthy_condition: The forced-value checkbox transitions from checked to unchecked after the 10-second wait.
steps.failure_condition: The checkbox remains checked beyond 10 seconds, or it is unchecked too early.

actions.label: Uncheck after 10 seconds
actions.exact_action: Wait 10 seconds, then uncheck the box for value OUT W1.

steps.title: Press CYCLE START to restart operation
steps.purpose: Restart operation after applying the forced OUT W1 value to recover from the non-recoverable AGV stuck fault.
steps.expected_result: "CYCLE START" is pressed and operation restart is initiated.
steps.healthy_condition: The system proceeds with the restart sequence after CYCLE START (operator can observe the restart behavior on the operator station HMI).
steps.failure_condition: Operation does not restart as expected after pressing CYCLE START.

actions.label: Restart operation
actions.exact_action: Press CYCLE START to restart operation.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the fault does not clear after applying the forced value and restarting, escalate to Fortna support for further troubleshooting (do not continue repeated forced-value toggling without guidance).

success_criteria: For the selected stuck tipper, OUT Fault Status shows value 82 on the CellIO Status screen.
OUT W1 forced value is applied by checking the enable checkbox for 10 seconds, then the checkbox is unchecked.
After pressing CYCLE START, the AGV-stuck fault clears (operator observes the fault condition resolved as part of the restart behavior).
healthy_conditions: On CellIO Status for the selected tipper: OUT Fault Status = 82 prior to forcing.
OUT W1 forced value enable checkbox is checked for 10 seconds and then unchecked.
After CYCLE START, the system restarts operation without the AGV remaining stuck at the tipper.
failure_conditions: OUT Fault Status is not 82 for the selected tipper.
The fault does not clear after applying the forced value and restarting.
escalation_guidance: If the fault does not clear after applying the forced value and restarting, escalate to Fortna support for further troubleshooting (do not continue repeated forced-value toggling without guidance).
